definitions.explanation: An official check conducted by police or authorities, typically on roads to inspect vehicles and drivers, or at other locations for security purposes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{検問|けんもん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っかかった→引っかかる：12455_hikkakaru⟧。
examples.english: I got caught at a police checkpoint.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{飲酒運転|いんしゅうんてん}→飲酒運転：18486_inshuunten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{検問|けんもん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧。

⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{運転|うんてん}して→運転する：20318_untensuru⟧⟦いたら→いる：00495_iru⟧{検問|けんもん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{免許証|めんきょしょう}→免許証：03160_menkyoshou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{提示|ていじ}→提示：12905_teiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}められた→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: I was driving late at night when I came upon a checkpoint and was asked to show my driver's license.

notes:
USAGE:
{検問|けんもん} refers to official inspections, most commonly police checkpoints on roads. In Japan, police set up {検問|けんもん} to check for drunk driving, unlicensed driving, and other traffic violations, especially during holiday seasons.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {検問|けんもん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っかかる→引っかかる：12455_hikkakaru⟧ (get stopped at a checkpoint)
- {検問|けんもん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ (conduct an inspection)
- ⟦{飲酒|いんしゅ}→飲酒：08635_inshu⟧{検問|けんもん} (drunk-driving checkpoint)
- {検問所|けんもんじょ} (checkpoint location)

The verb form {検問|けんもん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ means to inspect or question someone at a checkpoint.
